caption:
A simple way to split your paycheck. 🧮

If essentials (rent, food, bills, transport) take more than 55% of your take-home, that's your signal to look at one big cost first, not ten small ones.

Step 1: add up essentials.
Step 2: divide by take-home pay.
Step 3: pick the single biggest bill to attack.

What percent are you at? No judgment.
